name: IceCirc
description: IceCirc is a spin-off of Forschungszentrum Jülich's Institute for Integrated Computing Architectures (PGI-4/ICA) that designs low-power integrated circuits operating at cryogenic temperatures inside the cryostat, close to the qubits. Its cryogenic ASICs for qubit control and readout aim to reduce the wiring overhead, system complexity and power consumption of scaling quantum computers. The company is led by managing directors Jonas Bühler and Viktor Koch.
accessModel: Custom cryogenic IC design for quantum hardware makers

products.name: Cryogenic control and readout ASICs
products.description: Low-power cryogenic RF and mixed-signal integrated circuits for qubit control and readout inside the cryostat

highlights: Spun out of Forschungszentrum Jülich's PGI-4/ICA institute, building on more than a decade of cryogenic IC research
Targets control electronics scalable towards quantum computers with very large qubit counts
